tools.description: List published code sets (kodeverk) in Nav's Felles kodeverk with optional substring filtering and pagination. Example: {"filter": "post"} finds Postnummer.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on kodeverk name.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: list_kodeverk

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

tools.description: List published code keys for a specific kodeverk with optional substring filtering and pagination. Example: {"kodeverksnavn": "Landkoder", "filter": "NO"}.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on code value.

limit.description: Maximum number of codes to return (default 50, max 200).

offset.description: Number of matching codes to skip (default 0).

tools.name: get_kodeverk_koder

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

tools.description: Get code meanings (betydninger) with validity dates and language descriptions for a kodeverk, paginated over sorted codes. Example: {"kodeverksnavn": "Postnummer", "kode": "0150"} returns the poststed for 0150.

ekskluderUgyldige.description: Exclude meanings invalid on oppslagsdato (default true).

limit.description: Maximum number of codes to return (default 50, max 100).

offset.description: Number of sorted codes to skip (default 0).

oppslagsdato.description: Optional lookup date (YYYY-MM-DD) for validity filtering.

tools.name: get_kodeverk_betydninger

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

tools.description: List published hierarchies in Nav's Felles kodeverk with optional substring filtering and pagination. Example: {"filter": "geografi"}.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on hierarchy name.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

offset.description: Number of matching items to skip (default 0).

tools.name: list_hierarkier

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

tools.description: Get the node tree for a hierarchy, bounded by depth and root node limit. Example: {"hierarkinavn": "Geografi", "maxDepth": 2}.

limit.description: Maximum number of root nodes to return (default 50, max 100).

maxDepth.description: Maximum tree depth starting at 1 for root nodes (default 3, max 10).

tools.name: get_hierarki_noder

tools.description: Search kodeverk names or, when kodeverksnavn is specified, search codes and Norwegian Bokmål (nb) terms within that kodeverk. Example: {"query": "Oslo", "kodeverksnavn": "Kommuner"}.

kodeverksnavn.description: Optional kodeverk name to search codes and terms inside. When omitted, searches kodeverk names.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 25, max 50).

query.description: Search substring (2-64 characters; letters, digits, space, '-', '_').

tools.name: search_kodeverk
